theorems.name: Submission.dgid_dominated_pullback_integer_locallyIntegrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (F : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn Φ D → (∀ (A : Set (Euclid n)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → Measurable f → ∫⁻ v in A, f (Φ v) ≤ ∫⁻ x in Φ '' A, f x ∂μHE[n]) → Measurable F → (∀ K : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∫⁻ x in Φ '' K, F x ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)), (∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ ‖g x‖ₑ ≤ F x) → LocallyIntegrableOn (fun v => g (Φ v)) D volume ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume.restrict D), ∃ m : ℤ, g (Φ v) = m
